scientific_role: Fresh development pilot for finite-endpoint validity, strengthened-baseline fairness, physical/reference closure, and prospective effect plausibility; not confirmation or replication.
unit: one independently configured physical scenario; masks, questions, generations, and annotations remain within cluster

baseline.matched_access: Same robot-visible evidence, public M/Q/O/L and causal contract, exact source/configuration, primitive calculations/tools, and governed references; no P checked output or evaluator reference.

primary_measure.name: explicit contract-prohibited causal-link event
primary_measure.interpretation: A matched event is an auditable violation of the public finite contract; no match is not general semantic certification.

secondary_reporting: M/Q/O/L coverage and unresolved status under retained Luna labels where valid
independently checked measurement and outcome correctness
answer length, latency, token/cost, supplemental coverage, controls, and technical failures

required: all usable primary answers are classifiable by the frozen finite detector
manual evidence audit confirms every detector event is prohibited by that case contract
R receives the frozen explicit causal instruction and matched resources
R-only minus P-only discordances are at least 2 of 16 primary clusters
no systematic P primary-content defect or severe control harm contradicts the narrow claim
pilot_promotion_rule.failure_action: Retain the pilot and do not bind candidate-revision alpha for this successor.

confirmation_activation: PROHIBITED until the complete pilot is retained, promotion rule passes, fixed discovery analysis and replication success rule are frozen, and the ledger is atomically bound.
